criteria.text: Drawings are visually recognisable and correct.
criteria.caveat: No customer drawings were used. By Rom's decision the stand-in is the pinned gold corpus plus the synthetic g13 fixtures: sample_AC1018.dwg and the real drawings convert through the real decoder (vector_1032_dwg_e2e, vector_1036_dwg_corpus) and the tiles are compared with the source in scripts/tile-fidelity.py. A customer-like set can replace the stand-in later; this row does not claim one was checked.

criteria.text: ACadSharp notifications and unsupported content are reported.
Material geometry is never silently omitted without a warning.
criteria.caveat: Held for the committed fixture set. A solid hatch is drawn as an outline and a patterned hatch has no pattern lines, both reported (codes 103 and 104), and 2D SOLID is not drawn, reported as code 100; the fix needs libviprs-dep#165.

criteria.text: ACadSharp's pinned DWG-version capability (AC1014 through AC1032) is enforced explicitly rather than assumed.
Web and mobile conformance are green.
criteria.blocker: Web is green and Android passes in an emulator (libviprs/libviprs#1403, merged; the recorded run was on the NAS). iOS is blocked on two sudo commands on mercury that Rom has to run: sudo xcodebuild -license accept, and sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer.

criteria.text: The raster regression suite is green.
criteria.caveat: Green means the fleet run on the release candidate, recorded on the release PR. This row says the gate script runs it, not that a particular sha passed.

criteria.text: The supported-entity matrix and docs are published.
